``` ```{r} #| label: setup source("scripts/cargar_datos.R") # arboles + helpers esc <- function(x){x<-as.character(x);x<-gsub("&","&",x,fixed=TRUE);x<-gsub("<","<",x,fixed=TRUE);x<-gsub(">",">",x,fixed=TRUE);gsub('"',""",x,fixed=TRUE)} opciones <- function(v) paste0("", paste0("",collapse="")) bs <- read_excel("data/banco_semillas.xlsx", sheet = "Semillas") %>% mutate( familia = ifelse(tiene_valor(familia), familia, "—"), nombre_comun = ifelse(tiene_valor(nombre_comun), nombre_comun, ""), nombre_cientifico = ifelse(tiene_valor(nombre_cientifico), nombre_cientifico, ""), bkey = binomio(nombre_cientifico), iucn = iucn_de(nombre_cientifico) ) bs$con_html <- iucn_badge(bs$iucn, "en") col_ori <- if ("continente_norm" %in% names(arboles)) "continente_norm" else "continente" lut <- arboles %>% mutate(bkey = binomio(nombre_cientifico)) %>% filter(nzchar(bkey)) %>% transmute(bkey, slug, ori = ifelse(tiene_valor(.data[[col_ori]]), .data[[col_ori]], "")) %>% distinct(bkey, .keep_all = TRUE) bs <- bs %>% left_join(lut, by = "bkey") bs$ori[is.na(bs$ori)] <- "" bs$slug[is.na(bs$slug)] <- "" n_acc <- nrow(bs) n_fam <- length(unique(bs$familia[bs$familia != "—"])) n_esp <- length(unique(bs$bkey[nzchar(bs$bkey)])) try({ dir.create("recursos", showWarnings = FALSE) out <- bs %>% transmute(id, familia, nombre_cientifico, nombre_comun, origin = ori, conservation = iucn) write.csv(out, "recursos/banco_semillas.csv", row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8") }, silent = TRUE) sel_con <- paste0("", paste0(vapply(c("EN","VU","NT","LC"), function(k) sprintf("", k, iucn_label(k,"en")), character(1)), collapse="")) ``` The arboretum conserves **`r n_acc` accessions** of seeds and cuttings — a basis for **propagation**, **restoration**, **education** and **exchange** with other botanical institutions. Each species links to its profile; where available we show its **conservation status (IUCN)** and its **origin**. Search by name or combine the filters.

Download catalogue (CSV) Open data · free to use with attribution

```{r results='asis'} cat(sprintf('
%daccessions
%dfamilies
%dspecies
', n_acc, n_fam, n_esp, opciones(sort(unique(bs$familia[bs$familia != "—"]))), opciones(sort(unique(bs$ori[nzchar(bs$ori)]))), sel_con)) for (i in seq_len(nrow(bs))) { r <- bs[i, ] buscar <- tolower(iconv(paste(r$nombre_comun, r$nombre_cientifico, r$id), to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")) sci <- sci_html(r$nombre_cientifico) sci_cell <- if (nzchar(r$slug)) sprintf('%s', esc(r$slug), sci) else sci cat(sprintf('', esc(r$familia), esc(r$ori), esc(r$iucn), esc(buscar), esc(r$id), esc(r$familia), sci_cell, esc(r$nombre_comun), esc(r$ori), r$con_html)) } cat('
IdFamilyScientific nameCommon nameOriginConservation
%s%s%s%s%s%s
') ``` As part of the botanic-garden network (**ArbNet** accreditation and **BGCI** registration), we make our collection available to institutions, researchers and restoration projects through an **Index Seminum** (a list of seeds available for exchange). To request material, propose an exchange or donate seeds of regional species, get in touch via our [contact](contact.qmd) page. --- *Source: list of seeds and cuttings from Estancia La Constancia. Conservation status from the [IUCN Red List](https://www.iucnredlist.org). Updated by editing `data/banco_semillas.xlsx`.*
